title: 第九章 阵师稀少的原因第十章 第一道阵纹
content_zh:
“是的，镇北王府子弟皆修阵法，我的阵法造诣不算高，二妹拜在灵宝宗门下，阵法造诣还在我之上。”许玉华解释道。
“原来如此。大姐，实不相瞒，我对阵法着实好奇，现在又没什么消遣的东西，不知可有什么阵法的基础，让我在路上先学习学习？”白宣颇有几分不好意思地问道。
他也没什么坏心思，就是单纯的想要学阵法，然后成个仙，化个龙，创造个种族。
看着白宣迫切的样子，许玉华眼底深处浮现出一丝好奇之色，倒没想到白宣这么迫切，当即解释起来道：“三弟想学阵法是好的，但三弟可知为何阵师珍贵，然而这天下阵师却极是缺少，堪称万中无一呢？”
“因为权贵世家垄断，掌握着上等的阵法图和凝聚阵印的方法，概不外传，寻常人纵使天赋再好，若不卖身于他们，也难得真传。”白宣道。
反正方圆千里，没有一家有凝聚阵印的方法。
再往外面的话，就是大的郡城，都有阵法压制。
白宣不想惹不必要的麻烦。
影响他的报恩大计。
所以没去。
不然的话，白宣早就一家家光顾过去了。
听到白宣的回答，许玉华绝美的玉容微微一滞，我和你探讨修炼的问题，你跟我探讨政治问题？
不要跑题啊。
许玉华摇头道：“对，也不对。这是阵师无法壮大的外在原因，但成为一名阵师，本就是一件极难的事。”
垄断这些和你没有关系，你现在也是受益者，忽略掉这些不重要的问题，只谈客观的。
白宣露出乖巧的模样，努力聆听。
“在说阵师之前，先要说明阵法是什么。天地之间，万事万物都有其规律，姑且称之为天道。人乃万物之灵，自诞生以来，头顶天，脚踏地，便开始了对天地的探索，最终经过归纳，创造出了奇门遁甲之术，以奇门遁甲之术破解天道，然后以特殊的方式吸收天地灵气，借用天、人之力，实现种种不可思议之事。”
许玉华面色肃穆，腰板也挺拔许多，虽说她知道白宣不是真的，但未来西凉就是交给白宣，自然得尽心教导。
“而这个特殊的方式，就是阵纹！”
说到这里，许玉华指尖浮现出一道淡青色的纹路，紧接着又有数道纹路浮现，彼此交织在一起，原本有些昏暗的房间顿时明亮起来。

白宣也眼前一亮，看着纹路交汇，惊叹道：“这就是传说中的灵阵？”
“算不上，不过增加些许明亮罢了，连基础阵法都算不上，自然也算不上灵阵。真正的灵阵，可不是如此。”许玉华说着话，手中十道纹路迅速合成一道奇怪的印记，尔后阵纹交错，彼此共鸣。
然后许玉华挥手，窗户洞开，一道阵印飞出，落在外间，霎时间，数十道阵纹涌动，窗外立时间，天气元气涌动，苍穹之上，一道惊雷从天而降，强势劈下，远处一块巨石立时炸裂，发出一声惊天巨响。
“这才是阵法。”许玉华略带一丝自得地看向白宣，这是她最拿手的自然灵阵，足以震慑他人。
目光望去，果然见着白宣满脸的惊叹。
“大姐，教我！”白宣目光热切地看向许玉华。
那道天雷的威力，在他看来，平平无奇，连给他挠痒痒都不够。
他昨天渡劫时，每一道天雷的威力都远胜这道天雷的千倍。
他如今随手一拳的威力也胜过这一道天雷的千倍。
而且发动时间长，像段白语这样的武者很难硬接下来，但想要躲开却是轻而易举。
但问题不在这儿，问题在于，这个阵法对天地元气的运用效率，快赶上他了。
而他的修为可远胜许玉华。
而若是他当年和许玉华同境的实力，他要付出近乎是许玉华三倍的力量才能做到和许玉华一样的效果。
打个比方，他和许玉华的力量都是金银，许玉华只有十两白银，而他有一整座金山，但打斗的话，许玉华使用这十两白银去买锋锐的兵刃、坚硬的盔甲、优秀的战马，而他是单纯地用金子去砸人。
两人如果真的动手，许玉华不是他一合之敌。
毕竟他一座金山丢过去，一力破十会。
别说一个许玉华，便是成千上万个的许玉华，也不是他的对手。
可如果他面对的是一个拥有和他一样多的法力，然后又会阵法的人呢？
那不就危险了？
所以低调，然后学习。
content_en:
"Yes, the children of Zhenbei Prince's Mansion all practice formation techniques. My attainments in formation techniques are not very high. My second sister is a disciple of Lingbao Sect, and her attainments in formation techniques are still above mine." Xu Yuhua explained.
"That's it. Sister, to be honest, I'm really curious about formations, and I don't have much to do for fun now. Is there any basis for formations that I can learn on the road?" Bai Xuan asked rather embarrassedly.
He didn't have any bad intentions, he simply wanted to learn the formation, then become an immortal, a dragon, and create a race.
Seeing Bai Xuan's eager look, Xu Yuhua had a trace of curiosity deep in his eyes. He didn't expect Bai Xuan to be so eager, so he immediately explained: "It's good for third brother to want to learn formations, but third brother, do you know why formation masters are precious, but there is an extremely shortage of formation masters in the world, and they can be called only one in a million?"
"Because the powerful family has a monopoly, they have mastered the superior formation diagrams and the methods of condensing formation seals, and they are not spread to the outside world. No matter how talented ordinary people are, if they don't sell themselves to them, they will rarely learn the truth." Bai Xuandao.
Anyway, no one within a thousand miles has a method of condensing formation seals.
Looking further outside, even the larger counties and cities are suppressed by formations.
Bai Xuan didn't want to cause unnecessary trouble.
Affect his plan to repay his gratitude.
So I didn’t go.
Otherwise, Bai Xuan would have visited one by one.
Hearing Bai Xuan's answer, Xu Yuhua's beautiful face froze slightly. I will discuss cultivation issues with you, and you will discuss political issues with me?
Don't go off topic.
Xu Yuhua shook his head and said: "Yes, that's not right either. This is the external reason why the formation master cannot grow stronger, but becoming an formation master is an extremely difficult thing."
Monopoly has nothing to do with you. You are also a beneficiary now. Ignore these unimportant issues and only talk about objective matters.
Bai Xuan looked obedient and listened hard.
"Before we talk about the formation master, we must first explain what the formation is. Between heaven and earth, everything has its own laws, let's call it the way of heaven. Human beings are the spirits of all things. Since their birth, with their heads in the sky and their feet on the ground, they have begun to explore the world. Finally, after induction, they created the art of Qimen Dunjia. They used the art of Qimen Dunjia to decipher the way of heaven. Then they absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in a special way, and borrowed the power of heaven and man to achieve all kinds of incredible things."
Xu Yuhua's face was solemn and her back was much straighter. Although she knew that Bai Xuan was not true, in the future, Xiliang would be handed over to Bai Xuan, so she would naturally have to teach her wholeheartedly.
"And this special method is the formation pattern!"
Having said this, a light blue line appeared on Xu Yuhua's fingertips, and then several more lines appeared, intertwined with each other, and the originally dark room suddenly became brighter.
Bai Xuan's eyes also lit up. He looked at the intersection of lines and exclaimed: "Is this the legendary spiritual formation?"
"Not really, it's just a little brighter. It's not even a basic formation, and naturally it's not a spiritual formation. A real spiritual formation is not like that." Xu Yuhua spoke, and the ten lines in his hand quickly formed a strange mark. Then the formations intertwined and resonated with each other.
Then Xu Yuhua waved his hand, the window opened, and a formation seal flew out and landed outside. In an instant, dozens of formation patterns surged. For a moment outside the window, the weather energy surged. Above the sky, a thunder fell from the sky and struck down with force. A huge boulder in the distance immediately exploded with a loud noise.
"This is the formation." Xu Yuhua looked at Bai Xuan with a hint of complacency. This was her best natural spiritual formation, which was enough to intimidate others.
Looking around, he saw Bai Xuan's face full of exclamation.
"Sister, teach me!" Bai Xuan looked at Xu Yuhua eagerly.
In his opinion, the power of that thunder was mediocre and not even enough to tickle him.
When he went through the tribulation yesterday, the power of each thunder was far more than a thousand times that of this thunder.
The power of his casual punch now is a thousand times more powerful than this thunder.
andIt takes a long time to activate, making it difficult for a warrior like Duan Baiyu to catch it, but it is easy to avoid it.
But the problem is not here. The problem is that the efficiency of this formation in using the vitality of heaven and earth is almost catching up with him.
And his cultivation level is far superior to Xu Yuhua.
And if he had the same strength as Xu Yuhua back then, he would have to exert nearly three times the strength of Xu Yuhua to achieve the same effect as Xu Yuhua.
For example, his and Xu Yuhua's powers are both gold and silver. Xu Yuhua only has ten taels of silver, while he has a whole mountain of gold. But when it comes to fighting, Xu Yuhua uses these ten taels of silver to buy sharp weapons, hard armor, and excellent war horses, while he simply uses gold to hit people.
If the two of them really fight, Xu Yuhua will not be his enemy.
After all, he threw a mountain of gold and defeated ten guilds with one force.
Not to mention one Xu Yuhua, even thousands of Xu Yuhua are no match for him.
But what if he faced someone who had as much mana as him and knew how to use formations?
Wouldn't that be dangerous?
So keep a low profile and learn.
